recipe.visualDefinition: A central elliptical logo anchor surrounded by a radial array of circular headshots, set against a deep blue background featuring a halftone dot grid and thin white sunburst lines that connect the center to the perimeter.
coreVisualRelationships: Central elliptical focal point containing primary branding
Circular portrait frames orbiting the center in a tiered hierarchy
Radial lines creating a sense of energy and connection between subjects
Halftone texture providing depth to the flat blue background
coreInvariants: Circular framing for all secondary subjects
White or light blue glowing outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary branding in a large central ellipse; largest portrait at the top center; smaller portraits arranged in two concentric arcs below and to the sides.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blue ellipse with a white glowing border.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central logo, moves to the top large portrait, then follows the circular path clockwise around the perimeter.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Filled with a rhythmic halftone dot pattern and thin radiating lines to maintain high energy.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy to royal blue gradient background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for text, outlines, and sunburst lines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan or light blue for glowing effects and neon-style lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white elements and dark blue background; moderate saturation in portraits.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm background tones like red or orange

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Script for the main title; condensed sans-serif for the subtitle.
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a fluid, connected script with a slight upward tilt
Subtitle uses a rigid, all-caps, heavy-weight condensed sans-serif
Outer glow effect applied to script lettering to simulate neon
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders in script are stylized to fit within the elliptical frame
Star symbol used as a separator in the subtitle line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of organic, fluid script with geometric, industrial condensed sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, tilted energy of the main title.
Matches the heavy, condensed, authoritative feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep blue gradient background with a subtle halftone dot pattern. Place a large glowing blue ellipse in the center. Arrange 11 circular photo frames in a radial pattern around the center, with one larger frame at the top. Add thin white lines radiating from the center to the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a white script title with a cyan outer glow inside the central ellipse. Add a horizontal line of bold, condensed white sans-serif text across the lower third, using a star symbol as a divider.

verificationChecks: Is the central ellipse the primary focal point?
Are the portraits arranged in a clear radial hierarchy?
Is the halftone pattern visible but not distracting?
Does the script text have a neon-like glow?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure all text is legible against the background
Check that radial lines align with the center of the ellipse
Verify the halftone pattern is consistent across the canvas
Confirm the script font has a consistent tilt
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial Blue Talent Grid + Central Ellipse Anchor + Script/Condensed Sans Pairing
